purpose: Test whether a frozen low-capacity deployable state-candidate representation can distinguish the randomized construction edit before any response-effect call. This is a support test, not PM value gold.

representation.fold_local_unsupervised_reduction: center on training rows and retain exactly three SVD principal components; test rows use the training center/basis

model_and_split.heads: four separate component-specific ridge least-squares classifiers
model_and_split.grouping: A/B of one semantic family always held out together; exactly two families per component per fold
model_and_split.fold_assignment: stable hash order within component, round-robin into six folds

nuisance_probe.model: same ridge lambda and grouped folds

interpretation.pass: The bounded representation can observe the designed distinction. It still does not prove ON helps; only randomized same-state outcomes can do that.
interpretation.fail: Revise or narrow the representation/support claim before effects. Do not turn failed observability into OFF gold and do not blame PM optimization.
